packet.title: Date formatting (implementation)
packet.summary: Implements format-date, format-time and format-dateTime on the picture engine, with every component and modifier, English names and fallback markers for other languages and calendars.

body.p: After , . Owns new src/format_date.c, src/function_library_format_date.c, tests/format_date_test.c. format-date, format-time, format-dateTime on the 2.9 engine: every component and modifier, English names, [Calendar: AD]-style fallback markers for other languages and calendars (). Done when fn-format-date, fn-format-time, fn-format-dateTime ≥ 90%. Spec: F&O 4.0 "Formatting dates and times". Done 2026-10-17 (): module header src/format_date_internal.h; all run cases pass (fn-format-date 124/124, fn-format-time 94/94, fn-format-dateTime 80/80, from 20, 19 and 5).
